beats.say: Saw grandma's sedan in half, drop her couch in the middle, and you have built a limo.
beats.svg: <g fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M120 330 L120 268 Q128 236 168 230 L250 224 L300 262 L300 330 Z'/><path d='M700 330 L700 224 L800 230 Q840 236 848 268 L848 330 Z'/><path d='M120 330 L300 330'/><path d='M700 330 L848 330'/><circle cx='200' cy='352' r='40'/><circle cx='780' cy='352' r='40'/><rect x='352' y='252' width='268' height='78' rx='14' stroke='#83FA0C'/><path d='M352 282 L620 282' stroke='#83FA0C'/></g>

beats.say: But drive off and the whole thing folds like a sandwich.
So you weld long steel beams under the car, front wheels to back.
beats.label: stretched frame
beats.svg: <g fill='none' stroke='#83FA0C' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M186 392 L794 392'/><path d='M186 418 L794 418'/><path d='M300 392 L300 418'/><path d='M500 392 L500 418'/><path d='M700 392 L700 418'/></g>

beats.say: Now the engine is up front and the old drive shaft cannot reach the back wheels.
So you fit a new one almost as long as the car.
beats.label: long drive shaft
beats.svg: <g fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M214 460 L766 460'/><circle cx='214' cy='460' r='16' fill='#000000'/><circle cx='766' cy='460' r='16' fill='#000000'/></g>

beats.say: But a shaft that long whips like a jump rope and smashes through the floor.
So you hold it up midway with brackets that still let it spin.
beats.label: center bearings
beats.svg: <g fill='none' stroke='#83FA0C' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M400 430 L400 460'/><circle cx='400' cy='460' r='26'/><path d='M600 430 L600 460'/><circle cx='600' cy='460' r='26'/></g>

beats.say: Now grandma hears every single word you say.
So you build a wall with a little window that slides shut.
beats.label: privacy divider
beats.svg: <g fill='none' stroke='#83FA0C' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'><path d='M336 224 L336 330'/><path d='M336 252 L336 282' stroke='#000000' stroke-width='16'/><path d='M322 252 L350 252'/><path d='M322 282 L350 282'/></g>

beats.say: And with the wheels that far apart, a limo needs three lanes to turn one corner.
Look at you. You just built a limo.
